meta.description: Registry for provisional tie-resolution classes for degenerate minima and equivalent candidates in Phase 3.

tie_resolution_classes.meaning: Degenerate minima are preserved as multiple admissible candidates unless an additional rule is declared.
Candidate preference may be weighted by residue compatibility without forcing global uniqueness.
Use an additional orientation-based metric to resolve ties between degenerate minima.
Prioritize candidates with higher future admissibility retention or stability.
Candidate retention may be bounded by declared branch-width constraints.
Multiple preimages may be treated as equivalent only under declared reconstruction equivalence.
Selection is delayed until further process evolution resolves the ambiguity.
No formal rule has been established for tie resolution in the target system.
